attributes.action: Establish a Commission to Create an Official National Anthem for England
attributes.additional_details: A National Commission should be established to explore & develop an anthem for England. Bringing together composers, lyricists, musicians, historians & the public, it should create a song that represents who we are today while honouring our history & traditions. God Save the King emerged as a popular song in 1745 and remains an important part of our heritage. However, like Scotland, Wales & Northern Ireland, England deserves an anthem that unites, inspires & is proudly sung by future generations
attributes.background: Inspired by the passion and unity shown through national anthems at the FIFA World Cup, we call for an official anthem for England to sit alongside God Save the King—a song that reflects England today and brings people together with pride at sporting events and national occasions.

rejection.details:
This isn't something that falls within the Government's responsibility: the use of the present National Anthem is a matter of tradition rather any legal or constitutional status.

You can find more information about the history and status of the national anthem here:

https://www.royal.uk/national-anthem
